Name: (CP) MyPerfectFarm
Author: PhantomHacker11
Description:
My mod includes all of the main maps, edited to look nice. There are no seeds, rocks, or other odd inconsistencies on the ground
- - - - - - - - - - -
[b]New in version 1.3:[/b]

- All maps have been updated to Stardew Valley v1.5
- Added new maps from 1.5
- Have changed most maps to keep as much of the original design as possible
- I will no longer go over every detail I change for the changelog, just the important stuff
- - - - - - - - - - -

If you have any problems with any of the maps like glitches or items not appearing and etc. please let me know and I will fix it when I can :)
